name: Adjustment 14
definition: Describes each adjustment made to the original price.

AdditionalType.name: Additional Type
AdditionalType.definition: Additional information to specify the type of adjustment.

PromotionEligibility.name: Promotion Eligibility
PromotionEligibility.definition: Identifies when the item is eligible or prohibited from a discount or adjustment.

PromotionCouponNumber.name: Promotion Coupon Number
PromotionCouponNumber.definition: May contain coupon number, discount code, etc.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Identifies the quantity of the item that is adjusted (can be less than the total quantity of the item being purchased).

UnitPrice.name: Unit Price
UnitPrice.definition: Contains the adjusted unit price (does not include tax).

Percentage.name: Percentage
Percentage.definition: Contains the percentage value of the discount (when applicable).

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Contains amount of the adjustment, exclusive of tax.

TaxOnOriginalAmount.name: Tax On Original Amount
TaxOnOriginalAmount.definition: Indicates whether or not tax was calculated on the original amount of the transaction. ||Note that false (or not present) indicates applicable taxes are based on adjusted amount.
